name: menged-backend
description: Express API for the Menged Fleet Operations dashboard, backed by a local Supabase (Postgres) database.

scripts.db:migrate: psql "$DATABASE_URL" -f supabase/migrations/0001_init_schema.sql && psql "$DATABASE_URL" -f supabase/migrations/0002_users_and_roles.sql && psql "$DATABASE_URL" -f supabase/migrations/0003_technical_tasks.sql && psql "$DATABASE_URL" -f supabase/migrations/0004_material_serial_no.sql && psql "$DATABASE_URL" -f supabase/migrations/0005_material_plate_no.sql && psql "$DATABASE_URL" -f supabase/migrations/0006_reception_reports_roles.sql
